reasoning: Florida’s current Senate polling in the last 45 days shows Republican Ashley Moody ahead by roughly 4 to 10 points depending on the poll and average, with the most recent aggregate around R+4.8. I did not find a current presidential general-election margin for Florida in the provided results, so the best-supported current race margin is the Senate race, which is Republican-favored.
